scorecard.method: AUDIT IN -> FINDINGS -> REMEDIATION -> VERIFICATION -> AUDIT OUT

layers.name: Frontend foundations
evidence: Local web release suite passed; 36 browser scenarios passed; public assets and responsive concierge checked locally.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:web-release && npm run test:browser:vault
layers.failureDetails: Current dirty release candidate has not been verified in a clean Preview or Production deployment.
layers.remediation: Commit an isolated release candidate, deploy Preview, then capture route, accessibility, console, and responsive evidence for that commit.

layers.name: APIs and backend logic
evidence: API security, resilience, idempotency, output-boundary, and serverless import tests pass locally across 41 routes.
layers.failureDetails: Authenticated staging and production API behavior for this dirty candidate is unknown.
layers.remediation: Run safe signed-user Preview probes and bounded Production acceptance after release approval; retain response status and deployment commit.

layers.name: Database and storage
evidence: Tenant migrations include forced RLS and public privilege revocation in source; migrations 001-003 are untracked/unapplied in this checkout; no live database or storage verification was performed.
layers.failureDetails: Applied schema, grants, RLS allow/deny behavior, backup policy, private object storage, and restore behavior are not production verified.
layers.remediation: Review migrations, apply them to an isolated staging database, run role-specific allow/deny tests and advisors, then complete a documented non-production restore drill before production approval.

layers.name: Authentication and permissions
evidence: Opaque signed-session, revocation, tenant ownership, admin-role, entitlement, and consent tests pass locally.
layers.testCommand: node scripts/user-session-test.mjs && node scripts/api-security-test.mjs && node scripts/clerk-identity-test.mjs
layers.failureDetails: Current production identity-provider configuration and signed-user flows were not inspected or exercised in this task.
layers.remediation: Verify a least-privilege staging account matrix, session revocation, admin denial, and tenant-crossing denial using the exact release commit.

layers.name: Hosting and deployment
evidence: Vercel output boundary passes with 56 static assets, 41 functions, no internal source leaks, and explicit forbidden-route controls.
layers.failureDetails: No clean Preview or Production deployment was created for the current candidate.
layers.remediation: Deploy only a clean committed tree to Preview, verify aliases/routes/assets/source boundaries, and bind evidence to deployment ID and commit.

layers.name: Cloud and compute
evidence: Function durations, fail-closed feature flags, spend limits, bounded concurrency, and isolated-worker contracts exist and have local tests.
layers.failureDetails: Runtime quotas, regional behavior, cold starts, saturation, and vendor failure behavior are unknown for the release candidate.
layers.remediation: Record Vercel plan limits, regions, concurrency assumptions, and a bounded staging fault/load exercise without enabling employer actions.

layers.name: CI/CD and version control
evidence: A pinned-action Node 24 workflow now runs the full deterministic release gate; clean-source preflight and source inventory tests exist.
layers.failureDetails: The new workflow has not yet executed in GitHub and the working tree remains heavily dirty.
layers.remediation: Create an isolated commit, open a review, require the Production Readiness Gate branch check, and verify the remote CI result before release review.

layers.name: Security and row-level security
evidence: Sherlock security review passes locally; source migrations show forced RLS and public revocation; untrusted job-content and SSRF defenses are tested.
layers.failureDetails: Database RLS/grants are not verified against an applied staging or production schema, and no database advisor result is retained.
layers.remediation: Apply reviewed migrations to staging, test anon/authenticated/service boundaries including cross-tenant denial, run database advisors, and retain redacted results tied to the migration digest.

layers.name: Rate limiting
evidence: Durable tenant/global rate limits, hashed partitions, fail-closed configuration, and local regression tests exist; a prior operator round trip proved Upstash reachability but current parity was not rechecked.
layers.failureDetails: Current deployed limits, alert thresholds, and behavior under concurrent tenants are not verified.
layers.remediation: Run an approved staging concurrency test and a bounded production readiness probe that records only aggregate decisions and latency.

layers.name: Caching and CDN
evidence: API and concierge data routes are no-store; index caching is explicitly short-lived; output-boundary tests pass.
layers.failureDetails: Live cache headers, invalidation, and cross-user cache isolation are not verified for this candidate.
layers.remediation: Verify Preview and Production response headers for public, private, API, and error routes and retain header evidence by deployment ID.

layers.name: Load balancing and scaling
evidence: Discovery work is concurrency bounded and provider circuit breakers isolate failing sources; serverless execution supplies managed horizontal routing.
layers.failureDetails: No measured capacity, queue-depth SLO, regional failover evidence, or tenant-fairness load result exists.
layers.remediation: Define beta load assumptions and run a capped synthetic staging test covering queue depth, rate-limit fairness, source failure, and recovery.

layers.name: Error tracking and logs
evidence: Content-free structured events, admin-only health/dependency routes, worker heartbeat state, audit-chain tests, and operator-alert queues exist.
layers.failureDetails: No production log-drain retention, alert delivery receipt, dashboard SLO, or on-call acknowledgement was verified.
layers.remediation: Configure an approved redacted log/alert destination, perform a synthetic non-user incident delivery test, and record ownership, retention, and acknowledgement evidence.

layers.name: Availability and recovery
evidence: Lease recovery, retries, circuit breaking, liveness/readiness endpoints, encrypted record recovery code, and a disaster-recovery runbook exist and pass local synthetic tests.
layers.failureDetails: Provider backup/PITR retention and an isolated restore have not been verified; RPO/RTO and alert delivery remain operator assertions rather than measured evidence.
layers.remediation: Verify backup/PITR configuration, restore into an isolated non-production target, measure RPO/RTO, validate reconciliation, and retain signed content-free evidence.

API responses have a no-store cache boundary
Concierge CSP blocks inline script attributes

Liveness, readiness, dependency, and worker health endpoints exist
Recovery plan and recovery drill are documented and implemented
AI use-case assessment gate and current assessment exist
